## Load packages and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)

gii <- read_csv(here("data", "HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"),
                locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")) %>%
  clean_names()

```
## Load world boundaries

```{r}
world <- st_read(here("data", "World_Countries_(Generalized).geojson")) %>%
  clean_names()
```

## Calculate diff in GII (2019 - 2010)

```{r}
gii_clean <- gii %>%
  dplyr::select(iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)
```

## Convert ISO2 codes to ISO3

```{r}
world_iso3 <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(iso, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c"))
```

## Join GII to world boundaries

```{r}
world_gii <- world_iso3 %>%
  left_join(gii_clean, by = "iso3")
```

## Check & preview
```{r}
world_gii %>%
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) %>%
  pull(country)

qtm(world_gii, fill = "gii_diff")
```

```{r}
summary(world_gii$gii_diff)

gii_clean %>%
  filter(
    nchar(iso3) == 3,
    !is.na(gii_2010),
    !is.na(gii_2019)
  ) %>%
  anti_join(st_drop_geometry(world_iso3), by = "iso3")
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

gii_map <- tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_diff",
    col = "grey50",
    lwd = 0.3,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      values = c("#762A83", "#AF8DC3", "#E7D4E8",
           "#D9F0D3", "#7FBF7B", "#1B7837"),
      breaks = c(-0.6, -0.1, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.6)
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "GII change\n2019 minus 2010")
  ) +
  tm_title("Change in gender inequality, 2010–2019") +
  tm_credits(
  "Data: UNDP HDR25; boundaries: Esri",
  size = 0.6,
  position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom")
)

gii_map

png(
  filename = here("gii_change_map.png"),
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  type = "quartz"
)

print(gii_map)
dev.off()
```
